title: Kicked Spicy Mexican Pork Tacos Al Pastor
description: Pungent and juicy Mexican dish featuring paprika and pickle, perfect for a quick fix, flexitarian-friendly tacos al pastor cooked on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together paprika, pickle juice, lime juice, and olive oil.
Add the sliced pork to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the pork from the marinade and cook on the grill for 5-7 minutes per side.
While the pork is cooking, grill the diced onion for 3-5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by slicing the cooked pork and placing it onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of grilled onion and a sprinkle of minced garlic.
Garnish with additional lime juice and pickle slices if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
